directive.quote: For valuable work, inspect the actual behavior and integrate the final correct implementation into the default branch using ordinary commits.

preserve: Current question sequencing, shared controls, suggestion feeds, answer validation and atomic answer/decision writes.
allowed_deltas: Retain generic decimal and opaque source-reference inputs with owner callbacks and shared draft identity; preserve current DATA-driven suggestions.
banned_substitutions: No source-specific verification, caller-controlled persistence partition or app-specific workflow in generic forms.

baseline.note: Retained repository behavior; no appearance redesign or deployed proof claim.

proof.note: Local component and source checks; no deployed or visual-completion claim.
